name: Matrix
_comment: Insert effect (audio passed through untouched, takes no instrument slot): a 16 x 64 drum step sequencer after the MIDIbox SEQ BLM; the grid is on the iPad/phone (shared Force hub), the skin holds transport, kit and presets. Notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA port 'Matrix' / 'MIDI Out'. vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin; the plugin is matrix_vst.cpp, built by build.sh.
